title: Karbala da kafan gareeb jeddah
body:
Karbala da kafan gareeb jeddah
karbala da kafan ghareeb jadha'n koi paway hussain(a.
s.
) yaad aandaeysar khulay weer day janazay tay bhe'nrh aaway hussain(a.
s.
<<MINI>>
) yaad aandaey
<<DIVIDER>>
(dohrha)bekafan day shehar da kafan jada'n (x2)
wich jag tay koi pendaey
kar yaad ghareebi bekas di
har munsif neer waheendaeye wain lagdae
<<DIVIDER>>
yoo ewain lagdaey bekafani dipiya hasrat syed(a.s.) mitendaeyjada'n aap rehya hai baajh kafanpiya aj taie'n kafan wadendaey
kejhi aa shaan hin shareefa'n tay dhee(s.a.) to'n nikhrhay huway musafir day
chaar(4) saalaa'n di dhee(s.a.) koo'n seenay tay (x2)
koi samaway hussain(a.s.) yaad aandaey
<<DIVIDER>>
zuljanah di shabeeh to'n puchday hain lahwa'nrha'n zeen to'n musafir dazuljanah momina'n day haalay wich (x2)paasa laway hussain(a.
s.
<<MINI>>
) yaad aandaey
<<DIVIDER>>
kendi taskoo'n khiraj dendi aey ronday ronday sabeel hanjwaa'n dinaam nehr-e-furat da koi (x2)bhul kay chaway hussain(a.s.) yaad aandaey
bahween(22) saalaa'n day putr wich dhhal gaey kon turda rehiya bazara'n wichkoi sajjad(s.
a.
) di za'eefi da (x2)wai'nrh paaway hussain(a.
s.
<<MINI>>
) yaad aandaey
<<DIVIDER>>
surkh parcham eendi mazar utay ahdaey koi nai'n oo'nda rehiya "gohar"naam mehdi(a.
s.
) da adl day keetay (x2)lab tay aaway hussain(a.
s.
<<MINI>>
) yaad aandaey
